project_info.theme: Techcombank World Cup semifinal question poster
project_info.color_palette: Sky blue, stadium green, red, black, white

main_subject.detail: A football tunnel poster with the Techcombank logo top right. Large headline asks 'BAN KET RUC LUA KICH BAN NAO SE XAY RA?'. Four footballers stand on stadium stairs facing different directions, each holding a ball. The front left player wears an Argentina-style light blue striped jersey number 10, the front right player wears a white jersey number 9, the back left player wears a blue jersey number 10, and the back right player wears a red jersey number 19. A translucent Techcombank diamond geometry overlays the tunnel and field opening.
main_subject.style: Cinematic pre-match question poster with dramatic tunnel perspective, realistic players, and national-team symbolism
